purpose: Inspect payment fee specifications with identical exact local filters in live and offline views.

fields.name: costRateConfigList
fields.meaning: Native rate configuration structures; fees are not calculated locally.
fields.unit: as declared by native rate objects

identity_description: Native itemId identifies each independent fee specification; preserve distinct IDs even for the same channel.
limitations: POST /api/fundCost/query.json on iglobalfundcontrol.alipay.com; fixed FUND_OUT_CHANNEL_TRANS_FEE, zero-based pageNo and qualified pageSize 5000. No business filters enter native requests.
Native itemId is the primary key; different fee specifications remain separate, without timestamp deduplication.

All six filters are exact local scalar matches in live and offline views. Repeated same-field values OR; different fields AND. Missing or null do not match; no substring, wildcard, comma splitting, trimming or coercion.
Full native records including unknown fields, nested costRateConfigList, precision, nulls and array order remain unchanged. Display order is lexical itemId. Fees are not computed.
Source native totals and acquisition coverage remain separate from matched_total. SDK validates identity, totals, page echoes and coverage; incomplete or conflicting acquisitions cannot publish.
Live does not publish. Only complete nonempty refresh publishes; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves the prior snapshot. No Get or new Duckdog import.
